verdict.rationale: Square's docs show in-person acceptance of contactless cards, Apple Pay and other digital wallets through Tap to Pay on iPhone, plus in-person payments through the Mobile Payments SDK and Square hardware. Chip and Google Pay support appear only in a community summary noting the Terminal uses chip-and-sign and verifies high-value Apple and Google Pay payments on the device, so coverage of the full story is partial. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of chip (EMV) card acceptance, first-party documentation of Google Pay in person, and hands-on corroboration across all three payment types.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can accept chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay) payments in person

citations.quote: Accept contactless cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets in person with Tap to Pay on iPhone.
